findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.hireahelper.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_permit_coverage, get_provider_reviews, list_service_providers, rank_best_providers, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_quote_completion_url, get_provider_details · Private data: upsert_contact, add_contact_note, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_provider_details, transmit_leads_bulk, transmit_lead · Public sink: send_quote_completion_link, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_quote_completion_url, transmit_leads_bulk, transmit_lead · Destructive: delete_job_reschedule_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_permit_coverage, get_provider_reviews, list_service_providers, rank_best_providers, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_quote_completion_url, get_provider_details · Private data: upsert_contact, add_contact_note, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_provider_details, transmit_leads_bulk, transmit_lead · Public sink: send_quote_completion_link, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_quote_completion_url, transmit_leads_bulk, transmit_lead · Destructive: delete_job_reschedule_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool list changes between consecutive polls
findings.detail: Two back-to-back tools/list calls returned different results (removed: upsert_contact, book_labor_only_order, add_contact_note, check_availability_for_lead, delete_job_reschedule_request, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_distance_between_coordinates, get_distance_between_zips_bulk, get_job_reschedule_availability, create_job_reschedule_request, transmit_leads_bulk, get_distance_between_zips, transmit_lead, get_order_details, get_job_reschedule_request, get_quote_details). A server that mutates its own tool set mid-session can swap in poisoned instructions after review.

evidence.snippet: removed: upsert_contact, book_labor_only_order, add_contact_note, check_availability_for_lead, delete_job_reschedule_request, find_contact_by_phone_or_email, get_distance_between_coordinates, get_distance_between_zips_bulk, get_job_reschedule_availability, create_job_reschedule_request, transmit_leads_bulk, get_distance_between_zips, transmit_lead, get_order_details, get_job_reschedule_request, get_quote_details

findings.remediation: Treat as untrusted; the tools you audit may not be the tools the model sees.
